findings.message: Mutable default argument `items: list[Item] = []` causes all calls that omit the `items` argument to share a single list instance across invocations, so items accumulate and leak between unrelated carts/calls. The previous `None` sentinel with an explicit fresh-list fallback was correct; this change reintroduces the classic Python mutable-default bug.
findings.suggestion: Revert to `items: list[Item] | None = None` and inside the function do `if items is None: items = []` before appending (or use a factory/fresh list each call).
